# IAM User & Role Hands-On Activity

## Goal
Create a low-privilege IAM user and allow it to assume an admin role, avoiding use of root credentials. Learn **trust policy vs permission policy** in practice.

---

## Step 1: Create IAM User

**User name:** `rohit-user`  
**Access:** Console access enabled  
**Policies:** None (user cannot do anything initially)  

> This user starts with **no privileges**.

---

## Step 2: Create Admin Role

**Role name:** `Human-Admin-Role`  
**Trusted entity:** AWS Account (allow users in this account to assume role)  

**Trust Policy JSON (auto-generated by AWS):**
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::<account-id>:root"
      },
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
    }
  ]
}

Explanation:

“Any IAM user from my account who is allowed can assume this role.”

Step 3: Attach Permission Policy to Role

Policy attached: AdministratorAccess (AWS managed)

Effect:

This role now has full admin permissions once assumed.

The role still does nothing until someone assumes it.

Step 4: Allow rohit-user to Assume Role

Policy name: AllowAssume-Human-Admin-Role

Policy JSON:

{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::<account-id>:role/Human-Admin-Role"
    }
  ]
}


Attach this policy to the IAM user rohit-user.

This allows the user to switch into the Human-Admin-Role without giving permanent admin access.

Step 5: How It Works

Login as rohit-user (no permissions yet)

Switch role → Human-Admin-Role

AWS issues temporary admin credentials

Perform admin actions safely

Credentials expire automatically

Key Points Learned

IAM User: Who is logging in (identity)

IAM Role: What permissions to temporarily gain

Trust Policy: Who AWS trusts to assume the role

Permission Policy: What the role is allowed to do

Explicit DENY always wins

Least privilege + temporary creds = best practice

Clean-Up

Delete rohit-user

Delete Human-Admin-Role

Delete AllowAssume-Human-Admin-Role policy

Prevents unwanted access and keeps account tidy.

ASCII Diagram (Human Role Flow)
IAM User (rohit-user)
        |
        | sts:AssumeRole
        v
IAM Role (Human-Admin-Role)
        |
        | AdministratorAccess
        v
AWS Services (full admin temporarily)

Next Steps

Practice breaking trust vs permission policies intentionally

Add more granular policies to roles (S3-only, DynamoDB-only)

Experiment with temporary credentials via STS
